Repo: /home/sprite/type (Tauri desktop app, apps/desktop/src/). This is a React 19 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind desktop notes app. I need a detailed, file-level implementation plan for a UI/component-unification task described below. Do NOT write code, just produce a step-by-step implementation plan referencing exact files/functions.

## Background (confirmed via prior codebase exploration)

The desktop app's left-side note navigation has two tabs: "Feed" (pseudo-folders auto-grouped by date, e.g. Today/Yesterday/Last week/June/2025) and "Folders" (the real user-created folder tree from the filesystem). Today these are rendered by **two entirely different component stacks**, not just different CSS:

- **Feed** — `apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/ui/feed-panel.tsx` always renders `<TreeNode>` (`ui/tree-node.tsx`) → `<TreeRow>` (`ui/tree-row.tsx`) for bucket rows and `<NavNoteRow>` (`ui/nav-note-row.tsx`) for note rows, with a `feedMode` boolean prop threaded through. Styling is hand-written CSS in `apps/desktop/src/app/app.css` (classes: `.item-row`, `.tree-pane .item-row`, `.feed-navigation-tree .item-row`, `.item-label`, `.note-count`, `.tree-guides`/`.tree-guide-vert`, `.icon-spacer`, `.tree-toggle`, `.folder-glyph`, `.feed-bucket-row`). Drag-and-drop hooks (`useDraggable`/`useDroppable` from `@dnd-kit/core`) exist in `TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` but Feed explicitly passes `draggable={false}` (feed-panel.tsx ~line 235), and `edgeSnap={null}` always, since Feed has no manual reordering (grouping is purely by date).
- **Folders** — `apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/ui/folders-panel.tsx` has an `embedded` prop; it is **only ever called with `embedded={true}`** (single call site: `apps/desktop/src/desktop/desktop-app-shell.tsx` ~line 401). When `embedded`, `FoldersPanel` renders `<SidebarFileTreeNode>` (`ui/sidebar-file-tree-node.tsx`) instead of `<TreeNode>` — a completely separate implementation built on shadcn/Tailwind `Sidebar*` primitives (`apps/desktop/src/shared/ui/sidebar.tsx`: `SidebarMenuButton`, `SidebarMenuSubButton`, `SidebarMenuSub`, `SidebarMenuBadge`, `SidebarMenuItem`). Its own doc comment literally says "without drag-and-drop" — `SidebarFileTreeNode` never calls `useDraggable`/`useDroppable`, so **folders currently cannot be drag-reordered or drag-moved in the UI at all**, even though the full DnD machinery (`apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/hooks/use-drag-drop.ts` — `useDragDrop` with `handleDragStart/handleDragMove/handleFolderDragEnd/handleNoteDragEnd`, wired into a `<DndContext>` in `desktop-app-shell.tsx` ~line 410) is fully implemented and only needs draggable row hooks to attach to. There is a *dead* non-embedded branch in `folders-panel.tsx` (`embedded={false}`) that also renders `<TreeNode>`, but it is never invoked in production — confirm/inspect this dead branch, since it may be reusable/removable rather than written from scratch.
- `folders-panel.tsx` was simplified in commit `4d727a9` ("Simplify notes navigation surfaces") which is what introduced `SidebarFileTreeNode` and dropped a `recent-tree-node.tsx` and DnD from the embedded path. This was an intentional past simplification by the repo owner, not an accidental bug — but the owner now wants folder/note drag-and-drop restored as part of this unification.

### The indentation bug (confirmed root cause)
When `shouldNestNotesInNavigation` is true (`notesListMode === "nested"` setting, computed in `apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/state/use-notes-tree-state.ts` ~line 83), notes render inline inside their parent folder. In `SidebarFileTreeNode` (sidebar-file-tree-node.tsx), the folder row always renders either a toggle `<button className="sidebar-filetree-toggle">` (14x14) or `<span className="sidebar-filetree-toggle-spacer">` (14x14 placeholder) plus `gap: 8px` before the `<Folder />` glyph (~22px total reserved), but the sibling note row (`sidebar-filetree-note-button`) jumps straight to `<File />` with **no equivalent leading spacer** — so note labels sit ~22px left of sibling folder labels at the same nesting depth. By contrast, in the `TreeNode`/`TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` stack (already used by Feed), `NavNoteRow` (`ui/nav-note-row.tsx`) always renders a matching `<span className="icon-spacer" />` (`.tree-pane .icon-spacer { width: 20px; height: 22px; }`, same as `.tree-pane .tree-toggle { width: 20px; height: 22px; }` in `apps/desktop/src/app/app.css`), so folder and note icons/labels align correctly there already.

### Hover/selected style difference (confirmed root cause)
`app.css` has base shared row rules under `.tree-pane .item-row` (hover `#f7f9fb`, selected `#f4f8ff` with `inset 2px 0 0 var(--ui-accent)` box-shadow, `border-radius: 0`, no horizontal padding on ancestors → edge-to-edge/full-bleed square-cornered highlight). Feed additionally scopes `.tree-pane .feed-navigation-tree .item-row:hover`/`.selected` (app.css ~lines 805-820) to swap in `var(--sidebar-accent)`/`--sidebar-accent-foreground` (a near-white neutral, oklch(0.967 0.001 286.375) / oklch(0.21 0.006 285.885), defined ~app.css:52-53) including a text-color swap on hover/select — this is the "highlights full width horizontally" hover the owner prefers.
Folders' actual on-screen rows (`SidebarMenuButton`/`SidebarMenuSubButton` in shared/ui/sidebar.tsx) use Tailwind's `sidebarMenuButtonVariants` (`rounded-md`, `hover:bg-sidebar-accent`, inset within ancestor `SidebarGroup`/`SidebarContent` `p-2` padding) — a rounded, inset pill rather than a full-bleed bar. The owner wants the **Feed-style edge-to-edge/square-corner hover+selected behavior** to become the shared style for both Feed and Folders rows once unified.

### Font difference (confirmed root cause, decision made)
Root font-size is `14px` (`app.css` `:root`), so Tailwind's rem-based `text-sm` (0.875rem) computes to ~12.25px — smaller than Feed's hard-coded `.item-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; }` (folder rows) / `.nav-note-row .item-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 450; }` (note rows). Folders' Tailwind rows only go `font-medium` (500) via `data-[active=true]:font-medium` (bold only when the row is selected/active); Feed's rows are always weight 500/450 regardless of selection.
**Owner's decision**: adopt Folders' current behavior — regular/default font-weight normally, bold *only* on the active/selected row — but make note-row text a little larger than Folders' current ~12.25px for readability (owner said "slightly bigger notes" — aim for roughly 13px, still noticeably smaller/lighter than Feed's current fixed 14px/500 folder-label style, which should also move to "bold only when active" rather than always-bold).

### Guide lines (decision made)
Vertical tree "guide" connector lines (`.tree-guides`/`.tree-guide-vert` CSS, rendered inside `TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` via a `guideBaseLeft` calc using `depth`/`indentationWidth`) currently only render for Feed (`showGuides={feedMode}` passed from `TreeNode` into `NavNoteRow`, and `TreeRow`'s own `guideBaseLeft` differs by `feedMode`: `12 + indentationWidth/2` for feed vs. a hardcoded/broken magic-number `12 + 20 + 6 + 8` for the non-feed dead branch). **Owner's decision: guide lines should render identically for both Feed and Folders** once unified — so this magic number needs to be replaced with the same `12 + indentationWidth/2` formula (or another single shared formula) used for both modes, and `showGuides` should no longer be gated on `feedMode`.

### Drag-and-drop decision (decision made — important, re-read carefully)
The owner wants **real drag-and-drop for the Folders view**: both folders and notes should be able to be manually dragged/reordered/moved (this is expected core functionality they assumed already worked — they were surprised it's currently wired-but-disconnected). Feed should explicitly continue to have **no drag-reorder** (conceptually grouped only by date, `draggable={false}` stays as-is for Feed's `TreeNode`/`TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` instances) but Feed **does** need to keep working: shift/cmd-click multi-select, and right-click context menu actions (delete / move-to-folder) on the selection — this already works today via `computeRangeSelection` (`apps/desktop/src/shared/lib/selection.ts`) and the existing context-menu wiring in `feed-panel.tsx`, so just confirm it's preserved, don't newly build it.

For Folders, migrating rows from `SidebarFileTreeNode` to `TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` should mean `draggable` defaults to `true` (already the default in `TreeRowProps`/component signatures — confirm exact default), which reconnects the already-fully-implemented `useDragDrop` hook (`apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/hooks/use-drag-drop.ts`) and the `<DndContext>` wiring already present in `desktop-app-shell.tsx`. Investigate exactly what wiring is missing end-to-end (e.g., does `desktop-app-shell.tsx` currently pass drag handlers into `FoldersPanel`/`SidebarFileTreeNode` at all today, or are they only wired for `FeedPanel`? Check both call sites) — the plan needs to spell out precisely what needs to be connected, not just "it should work because the hook exists."

## What I need from you

Produce a concrete, ordered implementation plan (not code) covering:

1. **Component consolidation**: exact plan to make `FoldersPanel` render via `TreeNode`/`TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` (the same stack as `FeedPanel`) instead of `SidebarFileTreeNode`, including what happens to the `embedded` prop, the dead non-embedded branch (reuse vs. rewrite), and whether `SidebarFileTreeNode` + its supporting shadcn Sidebar usage (`shared/ui/sidebar.tsx`, `sidebar-filetree-*` CSS classes) should be deleted outright or left in place unused (recommend one, with reasoning — dead code should generally be deleted per this repo's conventions, but confirm nothing else depends on it, e.g. mobile or another sidebar mode).
2. **CSS reconciliation**: exact plan for consolidating `.tree-pane .item-row`/`.feed-navigation-tree` overrides into one shared set of rules (hover/selected edge-to-edge square-corner style for both modes), removing the `feed-navigation-tree`-only scoping where it should now apply globally, and adjusting `.item-label`/`.nav-note-row .item-label` font-size/weight to the hybrid decided above (regular weight by default, bold only when `.selected`, note text ~13px). Call out any dark-theme mirror rules (`app.css` ~2579-2618) that also need updating for consistency.
3. **Guide-line formula fix**: unify `TreeRow`'s `guideBaseLeft` calc (remove the `feedMode` branch, use one formula) and make `NavNoteRow`'s `showGuides` always true (or otherwise no longer gated on `feedMode`).
4. **Indentation fix**: since migrating Folders onto `TreeNode`/`TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow` should structurally fix the indentation bug (both stacks already handle icon-spacer/tree-toggle alignment correctly there), confirm this is genuinely resolved by the migration alone, or whether any additional prop plumbing is needed (e.g. `showNotesAsChildren`/`indentationWidth` passed consistently from `FoldersPanel` the same way `FeedPanel` does).
5. **Drag-and-drop reconnection for Folders**: exact steps to wire `TreeRow`/`NavNoteRow`'s `useDraggable`/`useDroppable` (via `draggable={true}` default) for real folder data, ensure `<DndContext>`'s `handleDragStart/handleDragMove/handleFolderDragEnd/handleNoteDragEnd` (from `useDragDrop`) actually fire for the Folders panel end-to-end (check `desktop-app-shell.tsx` for whether `FoldersPanel` currently receives these handlers or if they're currently only reachable via `FeedPanel`'s render tree), and confirm existing backend `moveItems`/`setOrder` API calls (`apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation` API layer) don't need changes.
6. **Selection/keyboard-nav consolidation risk**: note (don't necessarily solve in depth) that `apps/desktop/src/app/hooks/use-tree-interactions.ts` (folder-only click handlers) and `feed-panel.tsx`'s inline click handlers are still two separate implementations sharing only `computeRangeSelection` — flag whether the component-stack unification requires touching these too, or whether they can stay as-is since they already both feed into the same `TreeNode` props (`onSelect`/`onToggle`/`onNoteSelect`/`onNoteContextMenu`) regardless of which row-renderer is used underneath. Also flag `use-keyboard-navigation.ts` vs `use-feed-keyboard-navigation.ts` and whether `data-folder`/`data-note` attributes (used by `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded`) will now work for Folders once it renders via `TreeRow` (which does set `data-folder={node.id}` — confirm `SidebarFileTreeNode` didn't set these, meaning keyboard-nav scroll-into-view was silently broken for Folders and gets fixed as a side effect).
7. **Verification plan**: how to manually verify in the running dev app (`npm run desktop:dev` or similar — check package.json) that: Feed and Folders now visually match (hover/selected/font/indentation), guide lines show in both, folder/note drag-reorder and drag-move-between-folders works, Feed still has no drag but retains shift/cmd-click select + context-menu delete/move, and nested-notes-in-folders indentation lines up. Also note any existing tests (`*.test.ts` for `tree-ops.ts`, `dnd-tree.ts`, `notes-tree-model.ts`, `feed-tree-model.ts`) that should be run/extended.

Read the actual current contents of the key files before finalizing recommendations: `apps/desktop/src/features/notes/navigation/ui/folders-panel.tsx`, `ui/feed-panel.tsx`, `ui/tree-node.tsx`, `ui/tree-row.tsx`, `ui/nav-note-row.tsx`, `ui/sidebar-file-tree-node.tsx`, `hooks/use-drag-drop.ts`, `apps/desktop/src/desktop/desktop-app-shell.tsx` (the DndContext + FoldersPanel/FeedPanel call sites), and `apps/desktop/src/app/app.css` (the relevant selectors named above). Report exact line numbers for every change point you recommend.
